sources.snippet: 4D-VGGT Models This repository hosts the geometry-only checkpoint for 4D-VGGT Version 1.0. It supports camera parameter estimation, depth estimation, and world-space point-map estimation with the corresponding inference code in the 4D-VGGT repository.
